name: Biomedical Sciences PhD
summary: Biomedical science PhD with five concentrations and flexibility to select a laboratory and individual research plan after the first year.
detailsNote: Official information available; Fall 2027 dates not confirmed.

applicationFee.note: International fee $65; domestic $55. Graduate School says no waivers except currently enrolled ETSU graduate students. Confirm international category eligibility; no general hardship waiver.

english.note: Graduate-level central minima; PTE53 also listed. English exemptions depend qualifying country/education; see central policy.

documents: Transcripts (unofficial domestic copies for review; official after admission)
NACES-approved course-by-course evaluation of international transcripts
Personal statement, maximum 1,000 words, on research experience, ETSU interests and career goals
requirements.note: Minimum GPA 2.5 domestic and3.0 international on program requirements page. Three online recommendations should address research ability/academic preparedness. Interview may be required. Complete applications reviewed as received; all supporting documents due by published deadline.

funding.note: Program publishes graduate assistantships with tuition and fees paid and an undated annual stipend of $27,000. International guarantee and health insurance coverage not established on opened program funding page.
